totemic.page.totem_effects0: $(thing)Totem Effects$() are passive effects that always emanate from a $(l:basics/totem_poles)Totem Pole$(). They depend on the patterns that you carved into it:$(br2)$(carving)Bat$(): Makes you fall slowly and negates fall damage$(br2)$(carving)Blaze$(): Protects you against fires
totemic.page.totem_effects1: $(carving)Buffalo$(): Makes you mine blocks faster$(br2)$(carving)Cow$(): Gives you saturation$(br2)$(carving)Enderman$(): Gives you night vision$(br2)$(carving)Ghast$(): Gives you flight capabilities$(br2)$(carving)Horse$(): Gives you a speed boost$(br2)$(carving)Ocelot$(): Prevents Creepers from exploding$(br2)$(carving)Pig$(): Brings you good luck$(br2)$(carving)Rabbit$(): Gives you a jump boost
totemic.page.totem_effects2: $(carving)Spider$(): Lets you climb walls like a Spider$(br2)$(carving)Squid$(): Gives you water breathing$(br2)$(carving)Turtle$(): Gives you damage resistance but also slows you down$(br2)$(carving)Wolf$(): Gives you attack strength
totemic.page.totem_poles0: $(thing)Totem Poles$() are the centerpieces of Totemic. They can be crafted from any type of log or stripped log. Different patterns can be carved, which will lead to different $(l:basics/totem_effects)Totem Effects$(/l).
totemic.page.totem_poles1: Totem Poles need to have a $(thing)Totem Base$() at the bottom and can be up to 6 blocks high (including the base).$(br2)The same carving can be repeated multiple times on the same Totem Pole, making the effect stronger. A Totem Pole can also absorb $(l:basics/music)Melody$() which will make the effects stronger as well.
totemic.page.totem_poles2: An example of how a Totem Pole can look like.
totemic.page.totem_upgrades0: $(item)Totem Upgrades$() are special blocks that can be placed beneath the $(thing)Totem Base$()) to increase its range the range of your $(l:basics/totem_poles)Totem$() $(br2)There are currently two different Totem Upgrades:
totemic.page.totem_upgrades1: $(item)Totem Upgrade 1$(): Increases the range of your Totem Pole by 3 blocks$(br2)$(item)Totem Upgrade 2$(): Increases the range of your Totem Pole by 6 blocks
